question: Big Corp uses an IdP (Identity Provider) to manage access for its members to its Plus plan on Slack. Their security team wants to make sure members will be automatically deactivated when they leave the company. Which of the following must be true to ensure that members are automatically deactivated? A. Each member’s access must be set to expire after 90 days. B. The member must not be a Workspace Admin or Owner. C. The member who is leaving the company must have left all channels. D. The IdP must support deprovisioning via SCIM.
